reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the experimental finding of saturated phonon attenuation in metallic HEAs (P2, P6) with the concept of machine-learning calibration from computational studies (P5, P34) and the mechanism of force-constant fluctuations from multiple sources (P12, P24, P39, P41, P45) into a specific integrated predictive algorithm. It proposes a non-trivial coupling of advanced DFT capturing non-linear force-constant fluctuations with ML trained on experimental phonon data, an idea not stated in any single passage, and designs a falsification test that directly compares this integrated approach against standard DFT, addressing a gap between observed saturation and theoretical overprediction.
